usedFor: Slack holds team requests, and TimeCamp turns a channel message into work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Task” in TimeCamp
bestTemplate.why: A message in a chosen channel becomes a task in a TimeCamp project, ready for tracking.

watchOut: The Slack trigger includes bot messages and skips thread replies, so “Create Task” can run on bot posts.
